functions.name: get_basket_decision
functions.description: Call the same self-hosted Laya decision model used locally for an ambiguous shelf event. Returns candidate, option probabilities and model identity; never changes a cart.

eventId.description: Source event ID of the ambiguous case.

functions.name: get_shelf_event
functions.description: Read the immutable shelf event that opened a case.

eventId.description: Shelf event ID attached to the case.

functions.name: get_basket_evidence
functions.description: Read basket RSSI, zone, active sessions, and event metadata for the shelf event.

eventId.description: Shelf event ID attached to the case.

functions.name: get_cart_history
functions.description: Read current basket carts, sessions, recent orders, and case resolutions.
